description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Twisted Fate''' marks all targetable enemy champions, [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealing]] them for a duration. ''Destiny'' can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration.
description.text: Active: Twisted Fate marks all targetable enemy champions, revealing them for a duration. Destiny can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast - Gate:''' '''Twisted Fate''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] for 1.5 seconds before [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinking]] to the target location, [[File:Bullet strikethrough.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Homing projectile destruction]] [[:Projectile|destroying]] enemy [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectiles]] targeting him in the process.
description2.text: Recast - Gate: Twisted Fate channels for 1.5 seconds before blinking to the target location, destroying enemy projectiles targeting him in the process.

notes.text:
Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Twisted Fate cannot recast Destiny while grounded or rooted.
The nearsight from Paranoia will overpower the reveal from Destiny regardless of which one was cast first (enemy champions can still be revealed by Destiny after Paranoia ends if durations permit).
Using the recast will inform allies with a ping.
* Both allies and enemies can see an indicator at the targeted location of where Twisted Fate will appear.
The following table refers for interactions while Twisted Fate is channeling:
* Item actives with cast times as well as Titanic Hydra are disabled during the channel.
** Trying to cast a disabled item active will buffer it to cast at the completion of the channel.
